ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 60% low-intensity (black) pixels in the central region and 40% high-intensity (white) pixels on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity zone extends from the peduncle to the trailing edge, forming a wide 'U' shape. Lateral lobes are high-intensity (white) with significant low-intensity mottling. Notable focal dark streaks: a vertical line on the left lobe and a cluster of diagonal parallel lines on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 38 degrees and a vertical depth comprising 20% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular macro-serrations present along the entire continuous boundary. Peaks vary in pixel-amplitude from 5 to 18 pixels, creating a jagged, non-uniform profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal trajectory; concave curvature adjacent to the median notch, transitioning to convex across the mid-lobe, and ending in sharp, acuminate distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial clusters of small, dark circular pixel groups (scars) located on the distal white regions of both lobes. Light-colored circular focal points are also detectable within the central dark pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of a prominent vertical dark linear mark on the left mid-lobe and a series of parallel diagonal linear marks (rake-like) on the right mid-lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel rake marks on the right ventral lobe suggesting historical interaction. Irregularities in serration amplitude along the trailing edge suggest localized mechanical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical pigmentation patterns; the right lobe exhibits dense linear streaking while the left lobe displays more solid white areas with sparse mottling.
